messages.subject: Shiny html UI reactivity problem
parts:
I am getting a problem with reactive behavior when using HTML UI.

I have a tabset panel and input is given using select tag. Input is the different datasets as csv files.
Now the problem is that although the first tab generates output correctly, when I go to any second tab taking the same select option as reactive input,
that tab doesn't generate output automatically. I need to manually change the select tag's option to trigger further output.

Also, if I browse to the third tab or any other tab here onward, output stops completely. Changing select option now doesn't help too.

When writing UI using R language in ui.R, it works correctly.

messages.author: 23d5991a2e569ebe
messages.subject: Re: Shiny html UI reactivity problem
parts:
I solved the problem. It was occurring because I had made some error in including jquery file in my index.html.
I think I had included two different versions of jquery twice.
